perks.name: Warlord's End
perks.description: Powered melee hits weaken targets. Powered melee final blows create a burst of energy that dramatically weakens nearby targets. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the radius of the burst and the length of the weakening effect.

Enhanced Brick Chance is determined by the ally's Weapons Stat.
